No item, green cell, spreadsheet formula or passing test activates trading, paid providers, new workers, a restart or a scope expansion.
A new finding needs ID, parent requirement, why, source or exact violated invariant, evidence/reproducer, impact, dependencies and closure condition. Unknown origin stays unknown.
Keep the acceptance version that the work started under. Change it only with an explicit reason/owner decision. A different requirement is a linked item, not a silent edit.
Link exact test/run/config/code identity; verify normal caller, relevant failure/restart cases and touched frozen invariants. Mark only the demonstrated proof level.

Track per-screen functional proof, runtime truth and owner visual approval separately. No agent may award the owner's visual approval.

Warm-up, no opportunity, no eligible rule, disabled paid provider and policy-blocked research can be valid outcomes. They cannot prove an unexercised capability.
Summary counts are tracker workflow counts, NOT percent complete, weighted product progress or readiness. No fixed profitability/sample/retention thresholds are invented.
After each completed package: attach result, update affected IDs, add new issues, record history and select exactly one approved next ID in NEXT.
Identical immutable payloads may share storage. Distinct observation times/identities remain. Backups are intentional redundancy; retention/deletion requires a proved dependency boundary.
